fact: A DGI communiqué of 22 April 2026 says taxpayers can file IS and IBIC returns online through the E-Impôt platform, entering the balance sheet and profit-and-loss account and attaching financial statements, or upload statements through E-Liasse.

The DGI director-general says telefiling through the E-Impôt module, launched January 2019, now covers all taxpayers and all taxes except a few spontaneous ones such as registration duties and vignettes.

The DGI director-general says telepayment, launched December 2021, is operational for all taxpayers of the computerised centres, who can pay taxes by bank transfer, with no mobile money or card payment yet.

Mali's finance ministry project unit (PASG, AfDB-funded) sought a consultancy firm to extend DGI tele-services to all taxes, add a USSD app and APIs, and connect all tax centres to the SIGTAS network.
